parts.text: Fig. 2.1 shows a motorcyclist accelerating along a straight horizontal section of track. Fig. 2.1 The motorcyclist and motorcycle have a combined mass of 240 kg.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On the straight horizontal section of the track, the motorcyclist accelerates from rest at 7.2 m / s 2 .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) The motorcyclist reaches the end of the straight section of track in 5.3 s. Calculate the speed of the motorcyclist at the end of the straight section. speed = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 2(a)(i)
ms.text:
(speed =) 38 m / s
a = ∆v / ∆t OR (∆v =) a∆t OR (∆v =) 7.2 × 5.3

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the resultant force on the motorcyclist and motorcycle on the straight section of track. resultant force = ......................................................... [2]

ms.text:

F = ma OR (F =) ma OR (F =) 240 × 7.2
